newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SA Eagle launches new risk financing unit.
newsitem.headline: SA Eagle launches new risk financing unit.

text.p: The South African Eagle Insurance Co Ltd said on Monday it had launched a risk financing subsidiary firm, SA Eagle Risk Financing Ltd, after identifying business opportunities in this area.

Brian Wilkinson, deputy managing director of SA Eagle and CEO of Eagle Risk, said in a statement that the new company was seen as a complemetary service to clients via its broker network which already offers a wide range of insurance products.
He said that Eagle Risk was supported by SA Eagle which enjoyed a high degree of financial stability through its major shareholders, UK-based Eagle Star and Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd.
